definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is honest and sincere to the point of seeming naive or unsophisticated. Often implies a positive quality of earnest dedication without guile, though the character {愚|ぐ} (foolish) adds a note of self-deprecation.

examples.japanese: {愚直|ぐちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愚直|ぐちょく}な⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧だ。
examples.english: He is honest to the point of being simple-minded.

examples.english: I was moved by the craftsman who had earnestly dedicated himself to one thing.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {愚直|ぐちょく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {愚直|ぐちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (with honest simplicity)

NUANCE: Despite containing {愚|ぐ} (foolish), {愚直|ぐちょく} is often used positively to describe admirable dedication and sincerity. It's frequently used self-deprecatingly or to praise someone's earnest effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愚直|ぐちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work earnestly)
- {愚直|ぐちょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue steadfastly)
- {愚直|ぐちょく}な⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (to the point of being simplistic)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{実直|じっちょく}→実直：09186_jicchoku⟧ (honest, sincere - more neutral)
- ⟦{朴訥|ぼくとつ}→朴訥：09184_bokutotsu⟧ (simple, artless)
